dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Dodya is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Dodya has shown fearful behavior around leash handling, including scratching at the leash, thrashing, vocalizing, balking, and refusing to walk when leash pressure is applied. She can also avoid handlers when approached or picked up. Dodya when being walked enjoyed being carried but is intensely fearful in the care center, not interacting with staff and refusing to leave kennel. Medically, Dodya is healthy at this time.

Dodya was surrendered to the care center with limited history. Dodya has shown fearful behavior while at the care center, particularly around being walked on leash, where she has thrashed, vocalized, and balked. In calm environments, she has shown social behavior with staff, though remained avoidant of unknown handlers. Her previous owners also report that in a home environment she is affectionate and loves quality time with her family. Due to her fearfulness, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
